extName.message: Mail Triage - keep only what needs a reply

extDesc.message: Highlights only the emails that need your action. Ads and automated mail are dimmed. Works with Gmail, Naver Mail and NAVER WORKS.

noRows.message: Could not find the message list. Set a row selector in settings.

contextDead.message: The extension was updated. Please reload the page (F5).

errKeyRejected.message: The API key was rejected. Check it in settings.

errRateLimit.message: Rate limit reached. Try again shortly.

errNoAction.message: The response has no action field. See the console for its structure.

optLead.message: Fill in the role line and you are ready. Everything else works on defaults.

optRoleHint.message: Pick a job and the sentence fills in. Edit it freely. This sentence changes accuracy more than anything else.

optRolePlaceholder.message: Pick a job above or write your own.

optRoleTip.message: The more specific the better. This line is sent with every judgement and decides whether a message needs action from you. For senders you want handled with certainty, use the lists below instead.

optStrengthLooseHint.message: Highlights borderline cases too. More false alarms.

optStrengthBalancedHint.message: Recommended. You can change it after a few weeks.

optStrengthTightHint.message: Highlights only clear cases. You may miss some.

optPrivacy.message: Subjects and senders are sent to the classification service when you sort. Bodies and attachments are never sent. You can verify this in the source.

optSaved.message: Saved. Open your inbox and press Sort inbox.

optSavedIncomplete.message: Saved, but $MISSING$ is empty so sorting will not run.

optTroubleMe.message: My own sent mail is not recognised

optTroubleMeHint.message: Normally detected from the page. Fill this in only if detection fails. Separate name and address with a comma.

optTroubleCacheHint.message: Results are cached so repeats cost nothing. Clear it to force a fresh judgement.

optPrivacyWork.message: If this is a work account, check your organisation's policy first.

filterHint.message: Click to show only what needs attention

badgeDoneTip.message: Click to take this off the list

badgeUndoTip.message: Click to put this back on the list

optTroubleDoneHint.message: Messages you marked as handled will be highlighted again. Use this if you clicked by mistake.

undoneRerun.message: Restored. Press Sort inbox to re-check it.

marksGone.message: The list changed. Press Sort inbox again.

optAlwaysShowHint.message: Senders or subjects listed here are highlighted even when automated. One per line, a fragment is enough.

optAlwaysMuteHint.message: Senders or subjects listed here are skipped without being judged. No calls are made.

optBothLists.message: Saved. $LINES$ is in both lists, so it is always shown.

errNeedKey.message: No trial is available. Add your API key in settings.

errRelayQuota.message: This browser has used up its trial for today. Add your own key in settings to continue.

errRelayDenied.message: The free trial is not available in this region. Add your own key in settings.

errRelayPool.message: The shared trial pool for today is used up. Add your own key in settings to continue.

optSourceHint.message: Pick one. You can change this at any time.

optSourceTrialHint.message: The developer covers it with their own key. No sign-up needed, with a daily limit. Currently available in Korea only.

optSourceOwnHint.message: Sign up at console.typesafe.ai and create a key. It is stored on this device only and is never sent anywhere else.

optModeNoRelay.message: This build has no trial relay configured, so it runs with your own key only.

errRelayClosed.message: The free trial is closed for now. Add your own key in settings to continue.

errOwnKeyMissing.message: You chose your own API key, but none is saved. Add it in settings or switch to the free trial.

errStorage.message: Could not read your settings, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.

errRelayNew.message: New free trials are closed for today. Try again tomorrow, or add your own key in settings to continue now.

errRelayBurst.message: Too many requests at once. Please try again in about a minute.

errRelayVersion.message: The free trial relay does not accept this version of the extension yet. Try again later, or add your own key in settings.
